what: The PS2 price index: how eBay asking prices of used PS2 games moved, per site, 100 on the first day. Each day moves by the geometric mean of each game's change in median since its previous day, for games priced on both days from at least 3 copies; a median that doubled or halved is left out. Consoles are not in it.
points: [day, index, games compared with their previous day]; the first day counts the games priced. Finished UTC days only.
